$comment: Design-system enforcement config, read by scripts/ds-lint.js.
variantCeiling is the maximum number of values ONE style axis of ONE data-bn
declares 5. It is null on purpose: the mechanism is built, the number is the
owner's call. Run `node scripts/ds-lint.js` to see the current distribution
ranked, then put a number here.
While it is null the check reports and passes. Once it is a number, an axis
over it fails the build, and the only two ways to clear the failure are to
remove values or to write an ADR under variantCeilingAdrDir containing the
that exact count, so the axis cannot keep growing behind one ADR.
